item.title: Damsel in a Dress at King’s College offers free formalwear for those in need
item.description: Damsel in a Dress is returning to King’s College for its third consecutive year, continuing its mission of providing free donated formalwear to students and members of the wider community. Attendees can browse a range of gowns, dresses, and accessories at no cost in preparation for upcoming formal occasions, including prom, commencement balls, and other special events. item.title: COLLEGE SOFTBALL: Misericordia wins a pair of shutouts
item.description: MELBOURNE, Fla. — After dropping a pair of games on Monday during their spring break trip in Melbourne, Fla., Misericordia rebounded with two victories on Tuesday. The Cougars defeated Anna Maria College, 8-0, and Houghton University, 11-0. Both games were five innings. Misericordia scored three runs in the first to take a quick lead over Anna Maria.
